summary: Erotic Inferno is a 1975 British sex film directed by Trevor Wrenn. The note lists its main cast and notes an alternative title, Adam and Nicole. Mary Millington appears under her married name, Mary Maxted.
one_line: A 1975 British sex film directed by Trevor Wrenn, also titled Adam and Nicole.
key_facts: Erotic Inferno is a 1975 British sex film.
Erotic Inferno was directed by Trevor Wrenn.
Erotic Inferno stars Chris Chittell, Karl Lanchbury, Jennifer Westbrook, Heather Deeley and Mary Millington.
Mary Millington is credited in Erotic Inferno under her married name, Mary Maxted.
Erotic Inferno is also known by the alternative title Adam and Nicole.
